result.paraphrase: Zotac’s powerful GeForce RTX 2070 Super AMP uses NVIDIA’s cutting-edge Turing architecture to deliver stunning realism and exceptional performance in the latest games. It features 2560 CUDA cores, a 256-bit bus, 14 Gbps speeds, and boost clocks up to 1800 MHz. IceStorm 2.0 improves cooling with a larger surface area, an optimized heatpipe layout, a stronger aluminum array heatsink, and extra heat dissipation. Connectivity includes 3 x DisplayPort 1.4 and HDMI 2.0b with 4K support, plus HDCP compliance and support for up to four displays at once. Graphics cards include a 2-year standard warranty, with a 3-year extended warranty available if registered on Zotac’s website within 28 days of purchase.
